# ARender

> ARender is a document viewing and annotation platform that renders 400+ document formats (PDF, Office, CAD, email, images, video) in the browser. It is deployed as a set of microservices: a Rendition Engine backend and a viewer frontend. Two viewers are available: **ARender Classic** (GWT-based, production-proven since 2010) and **ARender Horizon** (React-based, new in v2026). Both share the same Rendition Engine — same rendering quality, same format support, same annotation backend.

ARender is typically integrated with ECM platforms (IBM FileNet, Alfresco, M-Files) or embedded in custom applications via JavaScript API or Web Component.

## Getting started

- [Architecture overview](https://doc.uxopian.com/docs/arender/overview/architecture): System components, Rendition Engine, Eureka discovery, Hazelcast caching
- [Docker Compose quickstart](https://doc.uxopian.com/docs/arender/quickstart/docker-compose): Run ARender Classic in Docker in 5 minutes
- [Spring Boot installation](https://doc.uxopian.com/docs/arender/installation/spring-boot): Standalone deployment without Docker
- [ARender Horizon getting started](https://doc.uxopian.com/docs/arender-horizon/quickstart/getting-started): Run ARender Horizon with React
